messages:
michael: Heads-up — VIP customer on Dedicated (us-west2) reporting lots of 429s and auth timeouts since ~08:05 PT. They say traffic is steady.
ana_support: Got their escalation ticket. Observed billing anomalies too — their invoice shows sudden egress/compute spike for the last 30m.
jake_sre: I'm seeing placement failures in us-west2 scheduler around 08:03-08:12: `placement: no compatible pool found` and alloc throttles. Autoscaler didn't add nodes; hitting `quota exceeded` on the reserved pool.
anya_eng: Can you paste the scheduler logs? Also which model and config? customer is on Dedicated-reserved with burst enabled.
jake_sre: log snippet:
```
[08:03:17] alloc_request id=abc123 pool=dedicated-us-west2-resv error=PlacementError::NoCapacity
[08:04:02] throttle id=abc124 reason=burst_concurrency limit=200 current=220
[08:06:11] auth_timeout user=vip-corp status=504 kv_error=redis:timeout
```
michael: Customer says their app saw latency go from 80ms -> 1200ms and a 10% error rate. They're asking if we fell back them to another region automatically.
oncall-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-0341. Severity: high. Pager rung for oncall.
ana_support: Billing CLI shows a usage spike flagged at 08:05 matching the errors: `dedicated.burst_compute` + fallback egress to us-west1 counted as cross-region egress.
billing-cli: flagged: invoice_delta=+$320 (estimated), reason=region_fallback_egress.
jake_sre: Root cause hypothesis: us-west2 had a transient GPU stockout after a maintenance reboot; scheduler tried to place on dedicated pool, queued tasks hit the burst throttle, and our fallback routing attempted cross-region placements which increased auth token latency (longer network path to KMS) and billing.
anya_eng: Repro steps for debug: 1) simulate steady stream to dedicated-us-west2 with reserved capacity set to 0.8 utilization; 2) trigger a node reboot in us-west2 staging; 3) observe scheduler placement and fallback policy; 4) capture `auth` latencies to KMS and token service.
michael: Customer asked for immediate mitigation — can we pin them to a smaller set of instances in us-west1 while we clear us-west2? Also they want cost guardrails so fallback doesn't auto-eject to cross-region without approval.
jake_sre: Short term: manual placement to us-west1 reserved pool for that customer; will disable cross-region fallback for their tenant. Long term: need autoscaler quota increase or warm pool in us-west2 and change fallback policy to prefer intra-region cold-queue instead of cross-region.
ana_support: Sent confirmation to customer: we will move them to us-west1 reserved and open charge dispute for the unexpected cross-region egress. They requested timestamps and repro logs.
anya_eng: Filed a runtime ticket to add a preflight KMS latency check before cross-region fallback and a billing-protect flag per-tenant. Also adding telemetry for `fallback_reason` in traces.
oncall-bot: Updated incident INC-2026-0341 with assignees: jake_sre, anya_eng. ETA for patch: 24h.
michael: Postmortem note: include timeline, exact cost impact per customer, and a runbook for manual pinning + toggling fallback. Also prioritize warm pool for high-tier Dedicated customers in each region.
jake_sre: I'll run mitigation now (manual migrate tenant -> us-west1 reserved). Will post updates when done.
ana_support: Customer acknowledged and paused their traffic while we migrate. :thumbsup:
michael: Thanks. Keep thread updated with migration completion and final billing remediation plan.
